action.objective: Convert the won queen for knight material: activate the queen with Qb5, hitting b7 and eyeing the exposed black king while keeping our king safe.
action.rationale: Qb5 is the only commit_ready move and the reserved verified candidate: depth-3 exact score +29, safety.complete with no immediate mate (tactical_refutation not_found). It wins a queen for a knight (material gain) since Black must still recapture the c7 knight with Bxc7. PV Qb5 then f6g4/g2g3 keeps the initiative with no Black forcing threats beyond Bxh2+ which is not mating. No risk acceptance needed.
